|lore=Member of Imperial Intelligence, Internal Security division. Assigned by IntSec to ''Executor''. Responsible for the physical safety of Imperial personnel against Rebel saboteurs.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at an Executor site, may use 1 Force to place any just lost non-unique smuggler (and all copies of that card in opponent's Lost Pile) out of play. Opponent’s spies and Jar Jar may not deploy to same non-docking bay site.

|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Corporal Derdram (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Corporal Derdram (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The cutout of the original slip preserves the Warrior icon of the [[:File:Dagobah-D-corporalderdram-decipher-archive.gif|underlying Decipher card]]. The later slip prints a standalone Pilot icon as well as Warrior. Both include the P2 piloting bonus in their game text. The period rules distinguish an icon outside the game text from a piloting bonus printed inside it. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=84 Pilot rules and icon]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=95 Virtual slips and printed pilot bonuses].

* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf Virtual Set #5 revised sheet] (publisher index dates the edition 19 June 2003), res.starwarsccg.org, page 2, slip 31.
